name: SchemaBoard – Automatic JSON-LD Schema Markup Generator
author: usarskyi

sections.description:
SchemaBoard creates JSON-LD schema markup for your pages automatically, so search engines can understand them. It builds a starter for every page from the page itself and your business details (optional AI drafts write a fuller version), shows which pages have schema markup (also called structured data), lets you review and edit it, checks it for mistakes and publishes it safely, all from one screen.

What is schema markup? A small piece of hidden code on a page that tells search engines what the page is about: a business, a service, an article, a list of questions and answers, a contact page. Search engines can use it to understand your content better. SchemaBoard makes no promise about rankings or rich results.

Who is it for? Site owners, marketers and agencies who want correct schema markup on every page without writing code.

What you can do

  • See every page at a glance. One table lists all your pages (and their translations) with the schema type, whether it is a draft or live, any problems found, and whether another plugin or your theme already adds schema.
  • Create schema in one click. For one page, or for every page that has none yet. Free starters are built from the page itself and your business details. Optional AI drafts (with a licence) write a fuller version.
  • Review before anything goes live. Everything starts as a draft. Nothing is shown to visitors until you publish it, and you can edit the code, preview it and go back to the previous version.
  • Edit where you already work. A panel in the block editor and a box in the classic editor, right next to the page you are editing.
  • Fill in your business once. Name, logo, photos, address, opening hours, area served and social profiles are entered once and reused on every page. Phone, e-mail and address stay on your site.
  • Check for problems. Errors and suggestions are explained in plain words, so you know what to fix.
  • Avoid duplicates. SchemaBoard finds schema that your theme or other plugins add. On pages where it prints schema, it can ask supported SEO plugins (such as Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO) to leave out their own, or remove other schema from the page.
  • Stay up to date. A flag shows when a page changed after its schema was approved.
  • Switching from SchemaBoard Lite? Its schemas can be imported in one click.
  • Made for multilingual sites. Translations are listed under their original page on sites with WPML or Polylang.

How it works

  1. Open SchemaBoard in the admin menu to see all your pages.
  2. Open a page and press Create schema. Review the result and edit it if you like.
  3. Publish. The schema is added to the page for search engines.

Free, with optional services

The board, editing, free starter schemas, the site scan and duplicate handling are free and work without an account. Two optional services use the SchemaBoard service, and you are asked to allow them first: Check for problems (checks a page’s schema against schema.org and search engine rules) and AI generation (writes a draft from the page text and your business details; a free trial licence with 5 generations needs only a SchemaBoard account, no payment details). Automatic drafts (off by default, on plans that include it) creates AI drafts for pages without schema once an hour and tells you on the board; it never publishes. Phone, e-mail and address never leave your site. Your schema stays active if a licence ends. External services below lists exactly what is sent and when.

External services

This plugin can contact the SchemaBoard service (api.getschemaboard.com). Nothing is sent before an administrator allows it. After that it contacts the service only for the actions below, plus the two small background refreshes at the end of the list.

  • First connection (right after you allow it): your site address, the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions, the environment type and the site language, to get an anonymous site token. No page content.
  • Check for problems: the JSON-LD of the page, the names of the placeholders used in it, the page type and language, your site address, and the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions with the environment type and site language. No page content, title or user data.
  • Activate a licence key: the key, your site address and the same version information.
  • AI generation: the page title, address, headings, main text (trimmed), summary, featured image address, the schema types already on the page, your site name, address and language, and the business details that are public by nature (name, description, hours, price range, profile links). Phone, e-mail, street address, other address parts, coordinates and personal names are not sent.
  • Automatic drafts: off by default. Only if you switch it on in Settings, the same data as AI generation is sent for pages that have no schema, at most once an hour in the background.
  • Background refreshes: the status of your licence or site token (when SchemaBoard screens read it, at most about twice a day) and the public list of supported schema types and checks (once a day, nothing about your pages). Both requests carry your site address and the plugin version.
  • Uninstall: if a licence is active, the licence key and your site address, once, to free the site’s place on it.

Page text sent for AI generation is processed in encrypted form for up to 24 hours and then deleted; the service never fetches your site. Terms of Service. Privacy Policy. What leaves your site, in plain language.

Source code

The files admin-ui/build/index.js and admin-ui/build/editor.js are built from human-readable source that ships inside this plugin, in admin-ui/src/ (TypeScript and React). They are minified build output, not obfuscated.

  • admin-ui/src/index.tsx builds admin-ui/build/index.js: the board, Business details, Licence & credits and Settings screens.
  • admin-ui/src/editor/index.tsx builds admin-ui/build/editor.js: the block editor panel.
  • assets/metabox.js and assets/metabox.css (the classic editor box) are written by hand and are not built.

To rebuild you need Node.js 20 or newer. In the plugin folder run npm ci, then npm run build. The build uses @wordpress/scripts (webpack); the configuration is in webpack.config.js and tsconfig.json, and the exact dependency versions are in package.json and package-lock.json. The output is written to admin-ui/build/.

Third-party code in the build files: React and the WordPress packages (wp-element, wp-components, wp-i18n, wp-api-fetch, wp-url, wp-data, wp-plugins, wp-editor, wp-edit-post, wp-primitives and react-jsx-runtime) are provided by WordPress itself at run time and are not bundled. One library is bundled: the icons and the small Icon wrapper used from @wordpress/icons 10.32.0 (GPL-2.0-or-later, source). The stylesheet is extracted to style-index.css at build time; css-loader and the other build tools are not part of the build output. There is no other third-party JavaScript.

Privacy

The plugin stores its settings, business details and schema in your database. It stores a site token and, if you activate one, a licence key, in non-autoloaded options; both are removed when the plugin is uninstalled. Uninstalling also removes the scan data and, if a licence is active, tells the SchemaBoard service to free this site’s place on it (one short request with the licence key and your site address). Schema and business details are kept unless you enable “delete data on uninstall”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open SchemaBoard in the admin menu. Pages in scope are shown on the board.
  3. Optional: fill in Business details, then open a page and press “Create schema”. Without a licence you get a free starter schema to review and complete; with one, AI writes it.
sections.faq:
What is schema markup (JSON-LD)?

Schema markup, also called structured data, is hidden code on a page that tells search engines what the page is about, for example a local business, a service or an article. JSON-LD is the format that Google recommends for it. You do not need to write it yourself: SchemaBoard builds a starter from your page and business details.

Will it improve my rankings?

Schema markup helps search engines understand a page. It does not guarantee higher rankings or rich results, and SchemaBoard makes no such promise.

Does it change my pages without asking?

No. Everything starts as a draft. Nothing is shown to visitors until you publish it.

Is my phone number or address sent anywhere?

No. Contact details stay on your site. Only placeholder names such as entity.phone are ever sent.

What happens if I close the tab while “Create schema for N pages” is running?

The run is worked from the board screen, so closing that tab, or opening another screen in it, pauses the run. Pages already done keep their drafts, and the run carries on when you open the board again. You can use other tabs meanwhile.

Is AI generation free?

The board, editing, placeholders, free starter schemas, the scan and blocking are free and need no account. AI generation and the cloud check use the SchemaBoard service: a free trial licence from your SchemaBoard account gives 5 AI generations to try it, with no payment details, and the annual plan adds more. Prices and what a credit is are on the pricing page.

What happens if I stop paying?

Your published schema stays in place. AI generation pauses until you renew. Everything else keeps working.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Yes. The site scan lists what they output and warns when SchemaBoard and another plugin describe the same thing. In Settings you can ask supported SEO plugins to leave out their JSON-LD on pages where SchemaBoard prints schema, or remove other JSON-LD from the page output. Removing other JSON-LD from the page output uses a filter that WordPress 6.9 provides; if your site or another plugin turns that filter off, this option has no effect.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • The board shows what a site scan found: a page without schema of its own names the other markup on it (for example “Other markup: LocalBusiness”), and the scan result says how many pages have other schema.

0.1.0

  • Board with coverage, filters and an editor drawer; block-editor panel and classic meta box.
  • JSON-LD output with placeholders; business details; Create schema (AI, or a free starter without a licence).
  • Check for problems, site scan for other plugins’ markup, breadcrumb proposals, stale-page flag.
  • Licence activation, AI generation with questions and provenance, review queue.

screenshots.caption: The board lists every page with its schema types and status, and shows how much of the site is covered.
The page drawer: schema code with placeholders, a resolved preview, Regenerate, Check for problems and Publish.
Business details are entered once and reused on every page. Opening hours are rows, one per day.
Licence & credits: paste a licence key (create a free trial licence with 5 AI generations in your SchemaBoard account, no payment details).
